facts.fact: Egypt Today reports the Ministry of Irrigation and Water Resources said a pilot of a satellite image analysis system producing crop type maps for irrigation water distribution and crop growth monitoring had begun in Kafr El Sheikh governorate.

systems.platform: machine learning on satellite images; RIBASIM for water distribution
systems.owner: Ministry of Irrigation and Water Resources

EGY.note: Document states nothing on rules or an authority on AI harms.
